backup.production_rule: One nullable column on staff_access_profiles (telegram_user_id, partial unique index, seeded 497550740 on Lloyd's admin profile) and two NEW definer functions (telegram_finance_decide_booking_v1, unreviewed_booking_receipts_v1). No existing function, grant or row is changed except that one seed. Take the backup, fill restore_point/verified_at, apply within one hour.

forward_verification.name: telegram_column_exists
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='staff_access_profiles' and column_name='telegram_user_id')

forward_verification.name: lloyd_mapped
forward_verification.query: select telegram_user_id = 497550740 from public.staff_access_profiles where user_id = 'fea44ac5-61b0-41a6-8616-d7823e99151b'

forward_verification.name: decide_denied_to_authenticated
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.telegram_finance_decide_booking_v1(bigint, uuid, text, text)', 'execute')

rollback.safe_until: always (drops two new functions and the mapping column; reviews already recorded stay)

feature_flags.name: edge_functions_call_tap_rpcs
feature_flags.required_state: telegram-expense v104 answers a tap with 'not switched on yet' while the RPC is missing; release-expired-holds v3 nudges nothing until unreviewed_booking_receipts_v1 exists; upload-booking-receipt v3 records evidence regardless (those RPCs already exist).

compatibility.evidence: New column is nullable and unread by existing code; new functions only. Rehearse on Alfred before apply.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
